name: Threshold
description: Port of FFmpeg's threshold filter: per channel, output the min clip where the input is at or below the threshold clip, otherwise the max clip.

inputs.name: threshold
inputs.description: Threshold clip (same size as the input)

inputs.name: min
inputs.description: Clip used where the input is at or below the threshold (same size)

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: Clip used where the input is above the threshold (same size)

params.name: planes
params.description: Bit mask of the channels to filter (1 = R, 2 = G, 4 = B, 8 = A); the others are copied from the first input
